spans.s: उद (only ˚— and adj. —˚) water.

उदक॑ n. water. — उदकं दा or प्रदा offer a libation
of water to a dead person (gen. or dat.);
 उदकं कृ the same, also =
˚कमुपस्पृश् touch cert. parts of the body with water ((r.)).
उदककर्मन् n. libation of water (v. prec.).
उदककार्य n. the same, + ablution of the body.
उदकक्रिया f. ˚दान n. = उदककर्मन्.
उदकदायिन् a. performing a libation of water.
उदकसेचन n. shower of rain.
उदकाञ्जलि m. a handful of water.

उदकान्त m. margin of water. ओदकान्तात् as far as the
water's brink.
उदकार्णव m. the ocean of water.

उदकुम्भ॑ m. a water-jug;
 N. of a physician.
उदक्त॑स् adv. from above or from the north.
उ॑दक्तात् adv. from above or from the north.

उदक्य a. being in water;
 f. आ a woman in her courses.

उदङ्मुख a. turned (lit. having the mouth or front)
upwards or to the north.
उदज n. lotus flower (water-born).
उदाज॑ m. selection, choice (also concr.).

उद॑ञ्चन m. pail or bucket for drawing water out of a
well.

उदञ्जलि a. hollowing and raising the palms (cf.
अञ्जलि).

उदधि॑ a. containing water. m. receptacle of water (cloud,
lake, or river, in l. l. the sea).
उदधीय् उदधी˚यति take a thing (acc.) for the sea.

उद॑न् n. wave, water;
 p. उदनिम॑न्त्.

2 उ॑दन्त a. running over the brim;
 n. adv. to the end.
उदन्त्य a. living beyond a boundary.
उदन्य् उद˚न्यति pp. ˚न्य॑न्त् pour down on (loc.).
उदन्य॑ a. fluctuating, watery.
उदन्यु॑ a. seeking water.

उदन्व॑न्त् a. = उदन्य॑;
 m. the sea.
उदपात्र॑ n. water-jug, ewer.
उदपान m. n. well, cistern.
उदप्रु॑त् a. swimming in water, splashing.
उदबिन्दु m. a drop of water.
उदमय a. consisting of water.

उदयगिरि m. the eastern mountain, behind which the
sun rises (cf. अस्त).

उदय˚शैल m. the eastern mountain, behind which the
sun rises (cf. अस्त).
उदयतट s. slope of the eastern mountain.
उदयाचल m. = उदयगिरि.
उदयाधिप m. the lord of rising, i.e. the Sun.*
उदयास्तमय m. du. rising and setting.
उदयिन् a. coming forth.
उदयोर्वीभृत् m. = उदयगिरि.
उद॑रण n. rising.
उदरंभर nourishing one's own belly, a glutton.
*उदरंभरि* nourishing one's own belly, a glutton.
उदरविस्तार m. expansion of the belly, corpulence.*

उदर्चिस् a. shining, luminous;
 m. fire.

उदवास m. dwelling in water;
 a. ˚सिन्.
उदवाह॑ a. bringing water.
उदश्रु a. weeping (lit. having one's tears up)
उदहार॑ f. ई fetching water.
उदाहार a. going to fetch water. m. the fetching water.

उदात्त a. elevated, high (lit. & fig.), highly or acutely
accented, sublime, illustrious, high-minded, generous, haughty,
arrogant. m. the high or acute accent.
उदान॑ m. the wind that goes upward (in the body).
उदारता f. ˚त्व n. sublimity (of style).
उदारचरित a. of noble conduct, acting nobly.
उदारधी a. of noble mind.
उदारशील a. of noble character.

उदासीन a. indifferent, passive, neutral;
 adv. ˚वत्.

उदाहरन n. saying, speech;
 example.
उदाहृत a. called, quoted.

उद्दाम a. unbound, unrestrained, unlimited, extraordinary,
full of (—˚). ˚— & n. adv. beyond measure, wildly, exultingly.
उद्दा॑लक m. N. of a man (lit. Up-tearer).
उद्दाह m. heat, fire.
